about_the_game:
About This Game

You play as Illya, a girl who has lost her memories, as she struggles to escape from a strange and intricately designed building.
This is a high-difficulty escape game, featuring the following unique systems:

Step System – Time Progression

Every action advances the “step” counter, and the situation changes accordingly.
For example, imagine a door that stays open for only 10 steps after being pushed.
You must pass through, complete your task on the other side, and return before it closes.
Take too many unnecessary actions, and you’ll find yourself trapped.
The order of your actions and the choices you make will determine your fate.

Weight System – Item Restrictions

Every item has a weight value.
The heavier your total load, the more steps each action consumes.
Where you could normally move 10 times with light gear, heavy equipment might limit you to only 5 moves.
Choosing which items to carry is just as important as solving the puzzles.

A Clear Goal

Your objective is to collect the keys needed to unlock the gate leading outside.

・Demo Version: Functions as a tutorial. Escape by collecting a single black key.

・Full Version: Requires five keys, hidden behind increasingly complex contraptions.

There is also a grim alternative: you may dismantle certain robots to obtain keys.
Illya will tremble, hold back tears, and reluctantly take them apart.
This shortcut may help you progress, but it also reflects the game’s cruel undertone.

Streaming Guidelines

Both the demo and full version may be streamed.
If possible, we kindly ask that you include a link to the store page in your video description.

Guide Illya—
a girl without memories—
as she searches for a way out of this strange and merciless building.
